answers.q1: Maven, using the checked-in wrapper (CI uses it; Gradle is an alternative). Install dependencies with: ./mvnw dependency:resolve (or ./mvnw -B compile). Maven also fetches dependencies automatically on the first build.
answers.q2: ./mvnw test (the full CI build, which also runs the format and checkstyle checks, is ./mvnw -B verify)
answers.q4: ./mvnw -B validate. This runs spring-javaformat:validate and the nohttp checkstyle check, both bound to the validate phase. CI runs ./mvnw -B verify, which includes them. To auto-fix formatting, run ./mvnw spring-javaformat:apply.
answers.q5: src/main/resources/static/resources/css/petclinic.css is generated from petclinic.scss plus Bootstrap, and is rebuilt with ./mvnw package -P css. The vendored fonts in src/main/resources/static/resources/fonts/ and the images in src/main/resources/static/resources/images/ should not be edited by hand. The Maven and Gradle wrapper files should also be left alone: gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar, mvnw, mvnw.cmd, gradlew, gradlew.bat and .mvn/wrapper/. Build output (target/, build/) is generated too. I did not check whether it exists, since the directory listing showed none.
